definitions.gloss: continuous service; length of service; tenure
definitions.explanation: The unbroken period of time someone has been employed at the same company or organization. Often used when recognizing long-term employees.

examples.english: I've been with the company for 20 years.

examples.japanese: {勤続|きんぞく}{年数|ねんすう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}→有給：04552_yuukyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Paid leave increases according to years of service.

examples.japanese: {勤続|きんぞく}30⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She was recognized with an award to celebrate 30 years of continuous service.

notes:
Compound of {勤|きん} (work/serve) and {続|ぞく} (continue). Refers specifically to unbroken employment at the same organization, which is an important concept in Japanese workplace culture where long tenure has traditionally been valued and rewarded.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勤続|きんぞく}〜⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧: X years of service
- {勤続|きんぞく}{年数|ねんすう}: years of service, length of tenure
- {勤続|きんぞく}⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧: long-service award
- ⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧{勤続|きんぞく}: long-term service
- {勤続|きんぞく}⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: longevity pay, tenure allowance

CULTURAL NOTE:
In the Japanese ⟦{終身雇用|しゅうしんこよう}→終身雇用：13852_shuushinkoyou⟧ (lifetime employment) system, {勤続|きんぞく}{年数|ねんすう} has traditionally been a key factor in determining salary and rank. Companies often hold ceremonies to honor employees reaching milestones like 10, 20, or 30 years.

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧ (metal), which is a much more common word with the same reading.
